entities.summary: Margarito, Margaritone da Arezzo or Margaritone d'Arezzo was an Italian painter from Arezzo, in Tuscany. Margaritone's given name was Margarito, but it was transcribed erroneously by Vasari as "Margaritone". It is by this latter form that he is still often known today.
